text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Look at this, Maruzen! There's a new

announcement on the bulletin board!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone just keeps achieving more and
more...
It's like they say, "In the ground
carrots lie, but
their leaves always reach
for the sky"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... the runners at this academy truly
are the
best of the best...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You have the potential to fill up this
whole board
by yourself with your
achievements, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! Maruzen?! No need to...
exaggerate...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No, I mean it. I truly believe you can do
it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hold your head up high, Chiyo! You've
got a
promising future ahead of you, and
you're cute to
boot!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! D-do you really think I'm... cute?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, even that was cute! And don't you
forget...
I believe in you.
